message.content: In December, Los Angeles typically enjoys mild winter weather. Average daily highs hover around **68–70 °F (20–21 °C)**, while nighttime lows usually fall to about **48–52 °F (9–10 °C)**. Overall, you can expect comfortable, sunny days with cool evenings—perfect for exploring the city without the intense heat of summer.
